properties.snippet: The Alaska Fuel Price Report provides information about actual energy costs across Alaska.
properties.description:
The Alaska Fuel Price Report was originally created in 2005 to inform former Governor Frank Murkowski's administration about actual energy costs across Alaska. The data in the original report was used to inform decision making relating to several programs, including:

  • Small Municipality Energy Assistance Program
  • Bulk Fuel Revolving Loan Fund
  • Fuel Bridge Loan Program
  • Power Cost Equalization
  • Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program
  • Power Project Loan Fund
  • Bulk Fuel Upgrades
  • Power, Fuel, and Hydro Training

The Division of Community and Regional Affairs (DCRA) continues to collect and release fuel price data to inform decision making. Since the initial report in 2005, DCRA has conducted 26 surveys to obtain heating fuel and gasoline prices from 100 selected Alaskan communities.

properties.snippet: Primary method by which a community receives it's fuel shipments according to the biannual DCRA Alaska Fuel Survey.
properties.description:
Primary method by which a community receives it's fuel shipments according to the biannual DCRA Alaska Fuel Survey.

Beginning in 2005, the Division of Community and Regional Affairs began collecting prices of heating fuel and unleaded gasoline in 100 select communities. The communities have remained constant since the project’s inception. While any given community may employ more than one method of fuel delivery, these data represent the most common means by which the community receives the majority of its fuel shipments.

This information is updated bi-annually around February and August, concurrent with the January and July fuel surveys.

properties.snippet: Alaska heating fuel prices from 2005 to present.
properties.description:
Alaska heating fuel prices from 2005 to present.

Beginning in 2005, the Division of Community and Regional Affairs began collecting prices of heating fuel and unleaded gasoline in 100 select communities. The communities have remained constant since the project’s inception. The prices for heating fuel in these 100 communities are collected via a telephone survey of each fuel retailer. Survey methodology has evolved over time; however, the reported prices should be considered representative of what a community resident would have paid for a gallon of heating fuel (including tax) on the day of contact.

This information is updated bi-annually around February and August, concurrent with the January and July fuel surveys.

properties.snippet: Alaska gas prices from the biannual fuel survey from 2005 to present.
properties.description:
Alaska gas prices from the biannual fuel survey from 2005 to present.

Beginning in 2005, the Division of Community and Regional Affairs began collecting prices of heating fuel and unleaded gasoline in 100 select communities. The communities have remained constant since the project’s inception. The prices for unleaded gasoline in these 100 communities are collected via a telephone survey of each fuel retailer and reflect an “at the pump” price per gallon (including tax) on the day of contact. The survey is generally conducted once during the summer and once during the winter in any given year.

This information is updated bi-annually around February and August, concurrent with the January and July fuel surveys.

properties.snippet: The Alaska Fuel Price Report provides information about actual energy costs across Alaska.
properties.description:
The Alaska Fuel Price Report was originally created in 2005 to provide information about actual energy costs across Alaska. These data were used to inform decision making relating to grant and loan programs administered by the Alaska Department of Commerce, Community, and Economic Development.

Since the initial report in 2005, the Division of Community and Regional Affairs (DCRA) has conducted 37 surveys to obtain heating fuel and gasoline prices from 100 selected Alaskan communities. The survey data continue to be used by public and private entities as a consistent frame of reference over time.

This report provides summary information about current fuel prices across Alaska, comparisons of historical fuel prices in the surveyed communities versus the national average, and interactive maps that contain both current and historical fuel price data.
